specials.title: Valentines Week Specials
specials.description:
Join us to celebrate Valentine's Day all week long! Specials are in addition to all of our regular menu items and are available all hours Wednesday through Saturday.

Soup- French Onion (bowl) $10

Appetizers-

Flash Fried Calamari with Marinara- $15

Whipped Feta with Roasted Tomatoes and Garlic Pita Rounds- $14

Creamy Hot Crab Dip with Pita Rounds- $16

Entrees-

Fisherman's Platter: flounder, shrimp, oysters, clam strips, fries, hushpuppies- $40

Pan Seared Lemon Caper Scallops: served over pasta, with crusty bread- $39 (add a smother of she crab for $8)

"Marry Me" Chicken: chicken breast cooked in a creamy sauce with garlic, parmesan cheese, and sundried tomatoes. Served with rice pilaf and asparagus- $28

Crown Club Filet Mignon: marinated filet of beef served with garlic mashed potatoes, grilled asparagus and burgundy mushrooms- $40

Dessert-

Chocolate Strawberry Trifle- $10

Special Cocktails:

Lover's Kiss Cosmopolitan- $12
Chocolate Covered Strawberry Margarita- $12
